title: dolichos helvolus
intro: Dolichos helvolus, commonly known as the velvet bean, is a plant native to Africa and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dolichos helvolus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include L-tryptophan, which is converted into serotonin in the body, and other compounds such as flavonoids and alkaloids, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
